retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic male portrait set against a vast desert landscape during golden hour, featuring high-contrast sans-serif typography anchored in the lower-left corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man in rugged attire, positioned slightly off-center against a soft-focus desert horizon. The scene is bathed in warm, directional sunset light creating a lens flare effect, with bold, two-tiered typography placed in the bottom-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject is illuminated by warm backlighting from the left
Typography is anchored to the bottom-left corner, overlapping the subject's torso
Background depth is achieved through a shallow depth of field
Color palette is unified by golden, amber, and earthy brown tones
coreInvariants: Rugged, textured clothing on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male subject, positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame, looking directly at the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold white typography in the lower-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the text, then out toward the sunset horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper-left and right background to allow the landscape to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and golden tones (background and lighting)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows/oranges; high value contrast between the white text and dark clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy and sunset hues

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the primary line
Ultra-thin stroke weight for the secondary line
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' in the secondary line has a low crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast: pairing a heavy bold sans-serif with an ultra-thin version of a similar skeleton.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and clean terminals.
Provides a similar modern, open-counter feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-quality photograph of a man in a brown utility jacket standing in a desert at sunset. Use a shallow depth of field to blur the distant mountains. Ensure warm golden light hits the side of his face and creates a subtle lens flare in the center of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold white geometric sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner. Directly underneath, place a second line of text in a thin, hairline weight using an orange-to-gold color that matches the sunset.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and directional?
Is the text aligned to the bottom-left?
Is there a clear weight contrast between the two lines of text?
Is the background a soft-focus desert landscape?

adjustableVariables: Specific desert topography (sand dunes vs. rocky mountains)
Text color of the secondary line
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and landscape

postGenerationChecks: Check for natural skin tones under warm light
Ensure text is legible against the subject's clothing
Verify the horizon line is level
Confirm the lens flare does not obscure the subject's eyes
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Rugged Male) + Setting (Golden Hour Desert) + Layout (Bottom-Left Heavy/Thin Typography) = Cinematic Country/Folk Aesthetic
